Vanessa — thanks for the ping. A few notes from procurement review:
1) Spend cap — $75,000 initial is within standard pilot envelope; we can approve provisional PO up to $75k.
2) Net 60 terms require Finance to sign off for new vendor banking/payment terms; I'll file a quick T&Cs exception request and CC Finance. Expect a response within 48h.
3) Line items: we prefer the following coding for downstream ledger mapping —
   - Line 1: Model Inferencing Credits — SKU: INF-STD (quantity/units as per their spreadsheet)
   - Line 2: Support (SRE hours) — SKU: SRE-HR (hourly block)
If GreenArk needs a currency designation explicitly on each line, flag it now.

Ben — you can provision a PO number once Finance gives the Net 60 nod (unless legal wants Net 30 in practice). If time-sensitive, issue a provisional PO with an expiration and note the Net 60 approval is pending.

I'll attach a procurement intake ticket with the exception request (ticket: PROC-7321).

—Monica
Sr. Procurement Manager

- Billing cadence: Net 60 flagged in header with pending Finance approval (PROC-7321).
- Expiration: provisional PO expires in 14 days if Net 60 not approved; we can switch to a final PO once Finance signs off.

Hi Ben/Vanessa — thanks for the fast turnaround. Two quick corrections before we finalize:
- Line 1 (Model Inferencing Credits): please change unit descriptor from "tokens" to "monthly credit units" so our billing maps to usage buckets.
- Line 2 (Support): reduce the initial hours block from 40 to 32 and set a tertiary line for "On-call escalation (per incident)" with placeholder rate so Legal can review.

We're good to proceed with PO-000472-PROV once those small edits are in place. Please send the updated draft and we'll get Finance to sign off on Net 60 quickly.

Leila Noor
